service.en: Report a resident's passport lost abroad
service.ar: فقدان جواز سفر مقيم خارج الدولة
service.ur: بیرون ملک رہائشی کے پاسپورٹ کی گمشدگی

about: Report and circulate a resident's passport lost outside the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Report a resident's passport lost abroad. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The page lists a departure permit as a related service
documents: Police report attested by the UAE embassy
channels: ICP Smart Services website (sign in with UAE PASS)
